repositoryAutomation.scope: deterministic build, source, generated-route, accessibility-contract, performance-budget, security, CMS, SEO, privacy, advertising, analytics, and served-output validation

liveAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Lighthouse reports for Home, Articles, category, article, and Contact with 90 or higher targets for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO, or an owner-approved documented exception.
75th-percentile LCP at or below 2.5 seconds, INP at or below 200 milliseconds, and CLS at or below 0.1 when sufficient production field data exists.
Complete keyboard paths and representative VoiceOver, NVDA, or equivalent landmark, heading, form, status, dialog, and error announcements.
Latest and previous Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge plus current iOS Safari and Android Chrome at 320, 375, 768, 1024, 1440, and 1920 CSS pixels.
200 percent zoom, 320 CSS-pixel reflow, text resizing, light and dark themes, reduced motion, touch, keyboard, and slow-connection checks.
All external legal sources, policy links, CDN resources, and social share destinations checked from the production network near launch.
Module 32 invitation, sign-in, logout, recovery, expiry, revocation, Editorial Workflow, GitHub to Vercel publish, rollback, and recovery evidence.
Monitored Contact and newsletter providers, successful and failure paths, rate limits, retention, privacy handling, and no-PII analytics evidence.
Approved GA4 property, consent behavior, DebugView, internal-traffic filtering, retention, Signals setting, and production-versus-Preview separation.
AdSense and certified CMP approval, regional consent, mobile density, no-fill, layout stability, policy, and before-versus-after performance review.
Domain ownership and TLS, organization/contact identity, source and image rights, production content quantity, and qualified legal/privacy review confirmations.
